title: Split an amount in cents by integer ratios with the largest remainder method
levels: Meets every requirement in the brief
Misses at least one requirement in the brief

cases.rationale: Integer quotients and remainders over one denominator, sorted by descending remainder then index, give the exact largest remainder split with ties to the lower index.
Sorting by (remainder, index) in reverse gives tied cents to the higher index, so allocate(100, [1, 1, 1]) returns [33, 33, 34] instead of [34, 33, 33].
It hands leftover cents out by index instead of by largest remainder, so allocate(100, [1, 2]) returns [34, 66] instead of [33, 67].
Exact fractions and a stable descending sort hand out the leftover cents by largest remainder with ties to the lower index, and invalid inputs raise ValueError.
